newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairie to see sun west, rain east.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairie to see sun west, rain east.

text.p: Canada's Prairies on Friday were forecast to see sun in the west and rain in the east, Environment Canada said.
Alberta should see sunny skies and highs of 12 to 16 Celsius.
Saskatchewan should see occasional showers with highs of 10 to 13 Celsius.
Manitoba should see 10 to 15 mm (0.6 inch) of rain in the Red River Valley with highs of 10 to 14 Celsius.
